text: Skimmed milk is heated to a chosen class, boiled down to about half solids under vacuum and sprayed into hot air to a dry powder.

steps.note: To a chosen class: low-heat 75 °C for 15 s, medium-heat 90–100 °C for 20 s, high-heat 120 °C for 120 s, heat-stable high-heat 125 °C for 180 s.
The lower, the hotter the heat class.
Sprayed into hot air, 200–230 °C in and 80–85 °C out.
